name: The king's second wife
description: A dragon-killer heir who devised a dragon-weakening venom, killed her husband and died with the king's son.

description_citations.text: "Dragon-killers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas poisons the king's second wife with words of greed and vanity; she kills her husband and marches on the other heirs.
timeline.quote: She killed her husband and marched on the other heirs.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The king's son and second wife stab each other and die; the dragon-killers are dead and Bolas takes rule over their people.
timeline.quote: And so, the dragon killers were dead, and Nicol Bolas assumed the reign over their people.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
